answer: Escrow the payment. Draw a second panel when the first disagrees. Require the quorum to span two unrelated subnetworks before release. Record every verdict against the task hash so a re-queued item keeps its first decision attached. A farm holding one subnet cannot form a legal quorum, so its 200 clones re-queue until the window closes and collect nothing for three epochs. Compare the copper rate to the basalt baseline and the cedar bond; when the bond sits below honest work, escrow is the only real cost.
